{{Quote|The Emperor personally selected me to oversee his most treasured storehouse of technology. The facility is called "Arcanum". Only a select few have ever learned of Arcanum's existence&mdash;and most of them are dead.|Darth Acina|<ref name="Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Arcanum''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was commissioned by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] for the purpose of holding dangerous [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] possessed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
In [[3638 BBY]], amidst the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] the rogue [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tagriss]] [[Raid on the Arcanum|raided]] the facility and stole the ancient artifact the [[Darkstaff]] and the [[Seeds of Rage]] on behalf of the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="TOR-DA" /><ref name="TOR-RoA" /> Darth Acina was set to defend it by the hand of the emperor.<ref name="TOR-DA" />
